_comment: Items in these kinds carry no label on purpose. `unclaimed` is how many were deliberately skipped when the kind was last reviewed; going over that budget flags the kind again so a real regression is not hidden behind a known exception. Keys match docs/inventory/kind-names.json.

a.sale_capsule.reason: package capsules share the Discounts & Events shelves with game capsules; a package has its own store page and its own score, so it gets no game label

a.daily_deal.sale_capsule.store_capsule.reason: the day's deal is sometimes a package rather than a game

div.capsule-banner.reason: a Labs experiment banner, not a game

div.+1h|.Panel|news,art,art≥50%.reason: an app page's own Recent Events & Announcements tiles link to the game whose page you are already on, which is never labelled

div.+1h|.carousel_items|app,art,carousel.reason: franchise and publisher sale spotlights carry a representative game's data-ds-appid for Steam's hover panel but link to a /sale/ page, so the tile is the sale, not that game (verified: Sniper Elite, Blizzard and 505 Games sale tiles on explore/next)

div.capsule.reason: a Labs experiment capsule, not a game

div.home_page_content.takeunder.reason: the hidden fallback anchor behind the home takeunder banner, with no art and no game

a..reason: a plain prose link on a package page, not a card

div.Panel+4h.reason: the Great on Deck 'Ignored' banner panel, not a game

div.exp_text_ctn.reason: a Labs experiment text blurb, not a game

div..reason: an app page's own game gets no label (verified: the 780x380 tile left unclaimed on each app page carries that page's own appid)

div.+1h|#SaleSection_N|app,art,carousel,.reason: the category hero is a rotating video carousel ("Next Game in 7 seconds"); the overlay claims the game's capsule, because Steam recycles the slide for the next game (verified on category/action, 2026-10-18)

div.Panel+1h.reason: a home deal panel stacks a game tile on a sale-page tile: the game tile is claimed rather than the panel, and panels holding only sale tiles are not games (verified on the home page, 2026-10-18)
